title: Reconcile Acceptance Ledger and Tear Down Proof Review Surface
description: Operator lifecycle command that materialises the acceptance ledger out of the ADR 0015 review volume into the committed evidence corpus, commits it, then tears the review surface down while preserving the ledger volume.
purpose: Persist the operator's recorded acceptance and signoff decisions from the running review surface into the committed evidence corpus as the manual operator reconciliation step, then stop the review surface.
outputs: A git commit reconciling the acceptance ledger from the review volume
Stopped review Compose service and Caddy container with the ledger volume preserved
sideEffects: Reads the acceptance ledger from the running review Docker volume
Creates a git commit of the reconciled acceptance ledger (not pushed automatically)
Stops and removes the review Compose service and operator Caddy container, preserving the ledger volume
failureSemantics: Fails closed if the review service is not running or the materialised ledger is not valid JSON with at least one action; on failure nothing is committed and the surface is left for inspection. The commit records the operator's own recorded decisions and does not itself upgrade any readiness claim; final signoff remains whatever the operator recorded in the cockpit.
aiGuidance: Use this command to reconcile operator-recorded acceptance from the review volume into the committed evidence corpus and tear the surface down. It git-commits the acceptance ledger but never pushes; the running service is never given repository write credentials. Do not use it to fabricate acceptance the operator did not record in the cockpit.
